# An ‘extraordinary’ execution

> The Daily Star has analysed 665 Saudi government press statements on executions from January 2024 to 20 October 2026 and found no other individuals—foreign or Saudi—were executed for fahisha during this period, making Nazrul and Sweety’s execution unusual.

Published by The Daily Star (Dhaka, Bangladesh) on 29 October 2026.
Reporting: Abdullah Hel Bubun and Tarek Hosen. Additional reporting: Keero Adnan Ahmed.
Planning & design: Abdullah Hel Bubun. Development: Mir Rownak and Abdullah Hel Bubun.

## Story

- [An ‘extraordinary’ execution](https://campaign.thedailystar.net/saudi-execution/): the full article with its charts, and the list of the 887 people named in Saudi Interior Ministry press statements, January 2024 – 20 October 2026.

## Sections

- Confusions over allegations
- Judge’s discretion
- Saudi’s ‘war on drugs’
- Killing foreign nationals
- Those who were executed

## Use

- Quote the article as written and credit The Daily Star with a link to the story.
- The names in the list were transliterated from Arabic into English with an AI model; spellings may differ from official records or from how families write them.
